about: A Go library that turns Markdown text into HTML.

prs.title: A heading on the last line of a document stays a heading
prs.broken: An underlined heading at the very end of a document with no final line break came out as plain text, sometimes with a stray horizontal line.
prs.changed: The underline now also counts when the document ends right after it.
prs.matters: Documents render the same whether or not the file ends with a line break.
